description: This is an Android Fragment class named HomeFragment that manages UI for displaying and searching a list of recipes. It interacts with view components such as RecyclerView, EditText, and custom StateView, and uses coroutines for asynchronous data loading.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of recipes with search functionality. Handles UI initialization, user input for search, and data loading via a repository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up event listeners, and loads initial data.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches recipes matching the search query and updates the UI state accordingly.
